subject: integration
name: Gnosis Chain light client
summary: Orivon's own build of Helios 0.12.0 with Gnosis Chain's parameters added, run only from files whose SHA-256 are pinned and re-hashed at load. Proves balances, code, storage, calls, blocks and receipts against Gnosis's sync committee; a signed transaction goes once to one server. Not Level 4: no checkpoint ships (one is stale in ten hours), so each start trusts two named beacon servers that agree; log queries and fee estimates are the server's word, and a log may be left out unseen; one default beacon server. Judged here by its publisher.
